architecture: two Pic8259 bus devices (master, slave), each with one two-port PortRegionBinding; state in Arc<Mutex<Pic8259Snapshot>> with an observer handle; not wired into the firmware board

isa_irq_vector.source: Linux IRQ0_VECTOR = FIRST_EXTERNAL_VECTOR + 16; no constant existed in the project

accepted.ocw3: RR/RIS select IRR (0x0A) or ISR (0x0B); both read 0

refused: ICW3 other than the cascade value
refusal_error: DeviceError::UnsupportedConfiguration, state unchanged; OCW2/OCW3 inside init: DeviceError::Busy
icw1_effect: clears IMR to 0, selects IRR, clears ICW2/ICW3 (as the chip)

port_map_check.mmio_devices: NVMe, ECAM, LAPIC, IOAPIC outside port space
